createOrReplace.title: Bachelor/CMS admission criteria & application ‒ Admission ‐ EPFL
createOrReplace.excerpt: EPFL introduces a limitation on the number of students in the first year of the Bachelor’s programs (3000). Applicants holding an International Baccalaureate (IB) from IBO.org are accepted in the first year of the Bachelor’s programs , within the places available (see above) , provided that their title fulfils all of the following conditions: the following subjects were studied and examined within the Diploma Programme (DP) at the higher level (HL): 1) mathematics, 2) physics, and 3) chemistry, biology, or computer science the total number of points scored is at least 38 out of 42 (excluding bonus points) and the grades in mathematics and physics are at least 6 out of 7 The general average (or total number of points scored) of the school-leaving certificate will be used to rank and select the applicants. the grades in mathematics and physics, as well as in chemistry, biology, or computer science, are at least A and/or 1 EPFL considers that level B2 in French (according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages ) is required to follow its Bachelor’s programs. Level C1 is highly recommended.
